content: Secrets-in-logs prevention: data minimization (don't log sensitive fields at all) beats redaction-after-the-fact. Type-level tagging of sensitive values prevents accidental string interpolation into logs. Stack traces and library error messages can embed secrets in larger strings making pattern-based redaction unreliable. URLs commonly leak tokens/query params. Defense-in-depth: static analysis for data flow + code review + redaction as backup layer, not primary control.
